svg.text: Tonight: my evening routine as four records
four aggregates: the evening, the track, the assignment and the review · three things outside: the college, Stephen and life · 12 scenarios, 6 of them real
yellow: me and my helper · pale: the records · green: the suggestion, a view · pink: outside · one real rule in purple; the rest are suggestions
neglect, my time and my mood
finished by me, or with AI help
rule: in by Sunday, never late
no rule: each one only pulls
Scenarios: what can happen, and the record that answers it
6 could happen: to check against my real routine
the rest with AI help; never late
I tell him: nothing to discuss
no LLM work, no home project:
the track is flagged, and moves up
work ran late, friends, too tired:
a game idea on homework night:
the quarter ends on a Sunday:
two due dates in one week
time for more than one track:
a split is allowed, and marked
the rest of the week is free
a holiday, or a Friday night:
1 The college sets the homework, due every Sunday, and now and then a project.
2 Each evening the tool builds a suggestion from the dates, tomorrow's review, neglected tracks, my time and my mood.
3 I pick what tonight is for. Usually one track for the whole evening: a suggestion, not a rule.
4 I do the work. Nothing is logged: this is a plan for tonight, not a diary.
5 The homework goes in before Sunday ends. If it runs long, the rest is finished with AI help.
6 On working mornings I review with Stephen, or tell him there is nothing to discuss.
What it remembers, and nothing more
• Whether this week's homework is submitted, and when the project is due.
• Whether something is ready for the next review.
• How many nights since each side track was last picked.
How tonight's suggestion is made: a proposed order
1 Homework, when Sunday is close and it isn't submitted.
On Sunday this is the rule, not a suggestion.
2 Design practice, when tomorrow is a working day and
3 A side track that has gone a week without being picked.
4 Whatever I'm in the mood for: a home project, or LLM
The order is my proposal. Tell me where it is wrong.
Two models of the same routine
carried from one week to the next
its own record, one per night
dates and people with their own life
seeing the whole week at a glance
